summary: NewChirp 1.0.54 on macOS 12.7.6: model-info (instructions) failed in ~50 ms with message '1' for read, write and settings. Not reproducible with the 1.0.54 bridge here; bundled Python minos is 10.15/11. Error text was an exception argument only.
title: Every action fails instantly with 'Reported error: 1' on macOS 12
